title: RW Aurigae — a young variable star
plain_result: 225 SPHEREx pictures over 2 visits. The star really changes brightness, and the colour-aware view keeps flagging it: 11 of the 101 remaining changes are at the star itself. A light curve (one brightness per picture after removing the star's colour) is not measured yet.
method_note: Counts use the frozen change model (revision 2). A variable star should keep showing up after correction; a still star should not.
